sourceReference: DRAFT profile written 2026-10-04 from Harris County Engineering's Wastewater Quality Permitting page and TCEQ's OSSF maintenance page. Contract submission only; inspection report submission is not published. See docs/jurisdictions/tx-harris-county-oce.md.

sources.title: Harris County Engineering: Wastewater Quality Permitting
sources.note: An owner of an approved and permitted OSSF system is required to have a Maintenance Contract with an OSSF Maintenance Provider ... Please submit your current Maintenance Contract to wastewater@harriscountytx.gov. Nothing about inspection reports. No last-updated date shown.

sources.title: TCEQ OSSF maintenance requirements
sources.note: Last modified 2026-03-03. Four-month reporting to the permitting authority and owner, within 14 days of the test.

unresolved: Harris County does not say on this page how maintenance inspection reports are submitted, so inspection filings are held for review and never sent.
Which parts of Harris County this office covers (cities may run their own programs) is not stated; every site needs a reviewed assignment.
No contract filing deadline is published by Harris County; the 30-day renewal timing comes from 30 TAC 285.7.
Harris County publishes no acknowledgment process.
The date Harris County's requirement took effect is not published; this profile applies from the day it was written.

applicability.howToDecide: Confirm with Harris County Engineering (Watershed Protection, Wastewater) or the site's OSSF permit that the county, not a city, permits this system. Record what you checked.

inspectionReports.note: Harris County publishes maintenance contract submission instructions only.

contracts.note: Harris County: submit your current maintenance contract to wastewater@harriscountytx.gov. Timing from 30 TAC 285.7.

confirmation.note: Harris County describes no reply to submitted contracts.
